title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1987-09-19
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 09/2011
source: OTS AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300 w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX90's, w/no Dolby. Taped by Ted Gidley.

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording that's still very listenable despite loud crowd
ai_review.review: The taping is praised for its overall quality and listenability even though the Saturday night audience was notably loud, which is typical for an audience source. No specific musical performance details are given, but listeners find this version enjoyable, noting that a different Oade recording sounds better.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights solid recording quality and overall enjoyment; lack of musical detail limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Loud audience on a Saturday night but taping is well done and remains very listenable; no major dropouts mentioned.
